items.source: Use HttpMessageWriterView to adapt and use any existing HttpMessageWriter (for example, JSON, XML) as a View.
items.translation: 使用HttpMessageWriterView来适配并使用任何现有的HttpMessageWriter（例如，JSON、XML）作为View。

items.source: Note that you must also configure FreeMarker by adding a FreeMarkerConfigurer bean.
items.translation: 注意，您还必须通过添加一个FreeMarkerConfigurer 豆来配置 FreeMarker。

items.source: Note that you must also configure script templating by adding a ScriptTemplateConfigurer bean.
items.translation: 注意，您还必须通过添加一个 ScriptTemplateConfigurer Bean 来配置脚本模板。

items.source: In addition, you can also configure defaultViews for rendering according to the requested content type, for example, JSON, XML, etc.
items.translation: 此外，您还可以根据请求的内容类型（例如 JSON、XML 等）配置 defaultViews 以进行渲染。

items.source: By default this property is not set, which means the result handler is ordered at Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该属性未设置，这意味着结果处理器按 Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE 排序。

items.source: Set the order for the ViewResolutionResultHandler.
items.translation: 设置 ViewResolutionResultHandler 的顺序。

items.source: Register a ViewResolver bean instance.
items.translation: 注册一个 `ViewResolver` Bean 实例。

items.source: Register a ViewResolver bean instance. This may be useful to configure a 3rd party resolver implementation or as an alternative to other registration methods in this class when they don't expose some more advanced property that needs to be set.
items.translation: 注册一个 `ViewResolver` Bean 实例。这可能有助于配置第三方解析器实现，或者作为此类中其他注册方法的替代方案，当这些方法无法暴露需要设置的某些高级属性时。

items.source: Whether any view resolvers have been registered.
items.translation: 是否已注册任何视图解析器。

items.source:
Set default views associated with any view name and selected based on the
best match for the requested content type.
items.translation: 设置与任何视图名称关联的默认视图，并根据请求的内容类型选择最佳匹配项。

items.source: Register a script template view resolver with an empty default view name prefix and suffix.
items.translation: 注册一个脚本模板视图解析器，其默认视图名前缀和后缀为空。
